name: deck-design-corporate
description: Builds DataArt "Corporate"-branded slide decks by composing slides on the DataArt Corporate Slides Kit (1920×1080, Arial: tokens/layouts/components CSS, ~30 pixel-faithful templates — covers, section, final, content layouts, process & timeline constructors, use-as-is slides — a showcase, and SVG/PNG assets). Use this whenever the user wants a DataArt deck, presentation, or slides, even without the word "kit". The kit is the ONLY source of visual components and final assembly: never substitute external UI frameworks (shadcn/ui, 21st.dev, Tailwind, Bootstrap), never invent a parallel visual system, and never edit the read-only kit. The kit is resolved by scripts/find-kit.sh; decks are written to the project directory, never the skill folder. Works two ways — a natural-language deck brief in chat (emit HTML + a short summary), or an AIMS64 handoff envelope (task_type deck YAML; follow references/aims64-handoff.md and emit deck_output).
